## How buying works

1. Browse the catalog (no account needed).
2. Tap Get a quote — WhatsApp opens with product, duration, and quantity.
3. ANC Tools sends today’s NPR rate.
4. Pay only after you agree (Khalti, eSewa, connectIPS, mobile banking, or card).
5. Access details usually follow the same day during Nepal daytime.

Prices are not listed on the website because supplier rates change.
